# Rakan Fadhil Prayata

> Personal portfolio of Rakan Fadhil Prayata, an Informatics Engineering graduate from Universitas Brawijaya with experience in web development and IT operations, and interests in AI, cloud computing, and networking.

The canonical website is https://rakanfadhil.com/. It is a single-page portfolio available in English and Indonesian through a browser language toggle. The section URLs below render the same page and scroll to the relevant section with JavaScript; they are not separate articles. Experience details open in dialogs, and projects can be filtered by category.

Experience includes web development at Tri-Wall Natura Surabaya, IT Staff at Tri-Wall Indonesia, the Bangkit Academy Cloud Computing learning path, and a Web Programming teaching assistant role at Universitas Brawijaya. Project categories are App/Website, Data Science/AI, Network, and Digital Content.

This website publishes portfolio information and a downloadable CV. It does not expose a public API, MCP server, A2A agent, or callable agent service. The ARD manifest therefore has an empty entries array. Contact links are for reaching the portfolio owner.

## Portfolio

- [Home](https://rakanfadhil.com/): Introduction and contact options.
- [About](https://rakanfadhil.com/about): Biography, education, interests, and technical stack.
- [Experience](https://rakanfadhil.com/experience): Roles, organizations, dates, and responsibilities.
- [Projects](https://rakanfadhil.com/project): Websites, applications, machine learning projects, home server, and multimedia work.
- [Certificates](https://rakanfadhil.com/certificates): Training and professional certificates.
- [Curriculum vitae](https://rakanfadhil.com/curriculum-vitae/CV_Rakan%20Fadhil%20Prayata.pdf): Downloadable CV in PDF format.

## Project repositories

- [Portfolio source](https://github.com/Ragraze/portfoliov1): This Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS portfolio.
- [Codeventure](https://github.com/Ragraze/codeventure): Web programming learning platform built with Laravel and Vite.
- [Flavory](https://github.com/Ragraze/flavory): Recipe application with meal planning and browser-saved favorites.
- [IKN Sentiment Analysis](https://github.com/Ragraze/ikn-sentiment-analysis): Thesis project using IndoBERT for sentiment classification and Top2Vec for topic discovery.
- [AgriSense](https://github.com/Ragraze/agrisense-webapp): Rice panicle maturity classification project using MobileNetV2 and TensorFlow Lite.
- [Classify Osteoporosis](https://github.com/Ragraze/classify-osteoporosis): Experimental knee X-ray classification project.
